Example: Pumping Bilges: May 2, 1974 - S/S JAMES - at Pier 15-6, Mt. Hope; C. Z. was discovered pumping bilges pierside. Master arrested and fined $100. U.S. Coast Guard notified. That agency has initiated proceedings to assess civil penalty of $5,000.
Example: Line Failure onboard vessel July 3, 1974 - M/V SIFNOS while taking bunkers at Dock 18-C, Balboa, C.Z. Shipboard line failed and oil flowed on deck, through scupper into the water. Master arrested and bail of $200 posted. Bail was forfeited. U.S. Coast Guard notified. That agency has initiated proceedings to assess civil penalty of $3,000.
